sourceState: unpublished working-tree draft; source hashes identify tested files
scope: Actual two-second nanosleep and unchanged deadline in native x86-64, native i386 and ELF64 INT80/i386 kernel-entry ABI
Complete GP/extended/code/scratch/signal-mask restoration; original masks include blocked SIGUSR1
13 controlled recovery failures with actual kernel requests, including errors before and after mask writes apply
Real queued SIGWINCH during the emulated entry; exact sender, UID and queued value independently inspected before actual delivery
Owned completed mmap retained after failures; idempotent retries, real protect/unmap and original console cleanup
Mandatory native gate requires all 219 x86-64 and 24 i386 mixed-restart assertions and success markers
limitations: SIGSTOP/group-stop/SIGCONT recovery is not implemented by this adapter
Foreign synchronous signals and syscall-user-dispatch policy still require actual adapter recovery tests
Cancellation and exit/exec across all adapter phases remain unproved
x32, other restart classes and additional kernels remain untested for this adapter
Mask exclusions are informed by Linux v6.18 source; current live tests run only the recorded host kernel
This evidence does not replace the published seven-job hosted CI report or complete the six-area compatibility objective
